title: ranunculus reptans var. filiformis
intro: Ranunculus reptans var. filiformis, commonly known as Creeping Buttercup, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. Creeping Buttercup is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which may contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
